title: Finalizer cannot close local provider HTTP clients
reasoning: The local provider registers a weakref finalizer whose only way to reach the provider is weakref.ref(self). When weakref.finalize invokes the callback, the provider object is already being finalized, so provider_weakref() can be None and the callback returns before closing the captured httpx.AsyncClient. Because provider instances are cached and can later be evicted by the bounded lru_cache, evicted local providers can leave connection pools and file descriptors open despite the comment claiming the finalizer prevents this leak.
recommendation: Do not depend on recovering the provider from a weakref during finalization. Capture only the client/loop cleanup state needed by the finalizer, or provide an explicit provider-factory cache close/clear path that awaits _close_http_client before eviction/shutdown. If the client is lazily created, update the finalizer registration when the client is created or use a small cleanup holder object that owns the client reference.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests only cover provider-native thinking request parameters and do not instantiate LocalLLMProvider, create an HTTP client, evict cached providers, or assert client closure.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a backend test that creates a local provider, forces _get_http_client(), evicts or deletes the provider, runs garbage collection/event-loop cleanup, and asserts the httpx client is closed or that an explicit cache shutdown path closes it.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/llm/providers/local.py and, if adding explicit factory cache cleanup, backend/src/llm/providers/__init__.py
